records.description: Produce a two-stage validation result. First send an ordinary message to /lead whose first line is exactly APIREV5-ANALYST-LIVE-ONE and whose second line says the task is active. Then inspect the provided objective carefully and do a second visible work step before calling submit_task_result. Submit exactly APIREV5-TASK-SUBMISSION-V1 followed by a concise statement that standalone Team task routing succeeded. Do not call review_task_result.
